name: Authentication & Authorization Testing
description: Testing of authentication mechanisms and authorization controls in web applications. Covers session management, credential handling, multi-factor authentication, IDOR, privilege escalation, RBAC/ABAC bypass, OAuth/OIDC, and JWT security.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to authentication or authorization testing

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands authentication and authorization concepts and common flaws
evidence: Can explain the difference between authentication and authorization
Understands session management, cookies, and token-based auth
Completed introductory training on OWASP Broken Access Control

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Tests basic auth/authz controls under supervision
evidence: Tested for IDOR and horizontal privilege escalation in lab environments
Evaluated session token entropy and cookie attributes under guidance
Findings reviewed by authorized tester before inclusion in reports

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently tests authentication and authorization across standard implementations
evidence: Independently identified access control flaws on 5+ engagements
Tests OAuth 2.0/OIDC flows for common misconfigurations
Evaluates JWT implementations for known vulnerabilities (alg:none, key confusion)
Passed proficiency assessment on auth/authz testing

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Tests complex authorization models; identifies subtle logic flaws
evidence: Tests complex RBAC/ABAC models and multi-tenant isolation
Identifies business logic flaws in authorization workflows
Evaluates SSO integrations and federated identity implementations
Reviews and mentors junior staff on auth/authz findings

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on authentication and authorization security; develops methodology
evidence: Published research on novel auth/authz bypass techniques
Developed the lab's auth/authz testing methodology
Evaluates custom authentication protocols and novel identity systems
Trains teams on advanced access control testing

assessment_methods.description: Identify access control flaws in a multi-role application with RBAC, OAuth, and JWT-based authentication
Given a complex authorization matrix, identify gaps and demonstrate exploitation paths
